PAYMENTS AND MERCHANT FINANCE | FY2018 - Q3 2026
G1-G6 | Central dependency spine
[I] Bet: monetize merchant commerce through payments and finance, balancing revenue growth against processing and credit costs.
|
|-- G2 Volume engine / G4 Shopify Payments
|   |-- [R] GMV x penetration -[D:mech]-> payments volume
|   |-- [R] Penetration: 40.4% FY18 -> 65.6% FY25
|   |-- [S] Q2 2026: 68%; 40 countries
|   `-- [I] Volume share, merchant adoption and accounting differ.
|
|-- G2 From volume to revenue
|   |-- [R] Volume x realized yield -[D:mech]-> Payments revenue
|   |-- [R] Seed: merchant solutions / GMV, 1.48% -> 2.33% FY18-25
|   |-- Penetration -[D:assoc]-> merchant solutions / GMV
|   `-- [I] PayPal gross recognition and displaced fees affect the mix.
|
|-- G2 From revenue to net take: the central test
|   |-- [R] Seed FY21-25: penetration +16.7 percentage points
|   |-- [R] Seed merchant solutions / GMV +46bp; GP / GMV +8bp
|   |-- [R] Seed GP / GMV after losses +1.4bp
|   |-- [R] Seed merchant solutions GP dollars: $1.40B -> $3.32B
|   |-- Penetration -[D:assoc]-> nearly flat loss-adjusted proxy
|   `-- [I] This aggregate proxy cannot isolate Payments economics.
|
|-- G2 Claimed strategic leverage
|   |-- Payments -[D:claim]-> better operating margins
|   |-- Payments -[D:claim]-> adoption of other merchant products
|   |-- Revenue -[D:untestable]-> checkout / finance reinvestment
|   `-- [R] Resource allocation uses consolidated net income.
|
|-- G4 Capital: scale, selection and risk
|   |-- [S] Cumulative funding: $885M FY19 -> nearly $4.7B FY22
|   |-- [R] Net receivables: about $92M FY18 -> $1.784B FY25
|   |-- Capital -[D:data]-> merchant growth / retention / attach
|   |-- [I] Selection prevents a causal reading of recipient outcomes.
|   `-- [S] Available to non-Payments US merchants since July 2019.
|
|-- G4 Other finance / G5 product expansion
|   |-- [S] Seed: Balance rollout 2020-22; Bill Pay launched 2023
|   |-- [R] Seed: Credit launched Q2 2023
|   `-- [S] Seed: Finance suite grouped products in Q3 2024
|
`-- G2 Cost of the layer: transaction and loan losses
    |-- [R] FY25: $417M; 16.8bp of payments volume
    |-- [I] That ratio includes losses beyond Payments.
    |-- [S] Q3 2025: onboarding experiments drove most of the spike.
    |-- [S] Q1/Q2 2026 total losses: 3.7% / 3.9% of revenue
    |-- [X] Payments normalization proves total losses stay near 3%.
    `-- [S] 2026 increases: Credit in Q1; Capital in Q2

Seed = inherited figure/date; source recheck may be incomplete.
GP = gross profit; bp = basis points; key and limits below.
